name: Aircall
one_liner: Cloud business phone system with a public REST API, webhooks, OAuth partner marketplace and AI Voice Agent platform.
auth_notes: Basic Auth with API ID + API token generated by a customer admin in Dashboard > Integrations > API keys. OAuth 2.0 auth-code (scope public_api) only for Technology Partner apps; client_id/secret issued by Aircall.
access_notes: Single-account use: any Aircall account admin can self-generate API keys (requires an existing Aircall account; plan/cost not stated). Multi-customer OAuth needs Technology Partner approval (~5 business days) before client credentials are issued.

buildability.rationale: Documented REST API; per-account API-key Basic auth is self-serve for admins; multi-tenant OAuth requires Technology Partner approval. 120 req/min per company; Calls/Contacts lists cap at 10,000 items. No official MCP (Aircall consumes MCPs; only community servers exist).

needs_human_reason: Which Aircall plans include API access, and sandbox details, are not stated on fetched pages.
